_comment: Proton builds the Linux runtime's Steam client can run a Windows game with. Tarball rows are downloaded by the app and unpacked by the session; depot rows are fetched by the Steam client itself. Only native ARM64 builds are listed - an x86_64 Proton cannot start here.

protons.name: GE-Proton11-7
protons.notes: GloriousEggroll's build, with its own game patches. Got GTA V Enhanced further than any other build tested.

protons.name: proton-cachyos-11.0-20260703
protons.notes: CachyOS's build, heavily patched for performance. Runs, but reached less of GTA V Enhanced than GE-Proton.

protons.name: proton-experimental-arm64
protons.notes: Valve's own ARM64 build, and what Bannerlator Proton (ARM64) runs. The Steam client downloads it; it is normally already here.

protons.name: proton-11-arm64
protons.notes: Valve's stable ARM64 build. Fetched by the Steam client.
